name: Caturix
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: name may mean king of battle
an obscure deity of central Europe

text: Caturix was a deity of the Continental Celts. Inscriptions to this little-known god turn up across central Europe. His name appears to mean king of battle. The occupying Romans equated Caturix with Mars, their god of war. The records summarize Caturix as an obscure figure.

okr.objective: Caturix is an obscure Continental Celtic war god later tied to Mars.
key_results: His inscriptions appear across central Europe.
His name may mean king of battle.
The Romans identified him with Mars.
The records describe him as obscure.
